topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh my gosh, I just can't believe it! Out of nowhere, I got this package, no idea what it was, and inside was this beautiful handwritten note and this little, perfect token of gratitude. It's from Sarah, one of my old students, you know? She's always had this knack for making the mundane magical, and here I am, choking up just thinking about it. It’s like, everything you ever poured out, every ounce of effort, it really does ripple out there in the world. I mean, we do this because we love it, right? But to have it come back to you like this? It’s the best. It's like the world just got a little brighter, you know?
